title: Oklahoma 17, LSU 13: Sategna's 58-Yard Winner in Norman
question: What was the score of Oklahoma vs. LSU on November 29, 2025?
answer: No. 8 Oklahoma beat LSU 17-13 in Norman on November 29, 2025. John Mateer's 58-yard touchdown pass to Isaiah Sategna with 4:16 left was the go-ahead score, even after Mateer threw three interceptions.
summary: Oklahoma beat LSU 17-13 on Nov. 29, 2025: Isaiah Sategna's 58-yard touchdown from John Mateer with 4:16 left sealed a 10-2 regular season finish.
body: On Saturday, November 29, 2025, No. 8 Oklahoma closed its regular season at home against LSU and won 17-13. It was not a smooth afternoon, but it was a memorable finish.

Tate Sandell opened the scoring with a 38-yard field goal in the first quarter, and LSU answered with a 25-yard kick from Damian Ramos. LSU then took a 10-3 lead early in the third quarter on a 1-yard touchdown pass from Michael Van Buren Jr. to Zavion Thomas. That drive began after Tigers defender A.J. Haulcy intercepted John Mateer and returned the ball 42 yards.
Mateer answered late in the third quarter with a 45-yard touchdown pass to Deion Burks to tie the game at 10. Ramos put LSU back in front 13-10 with a 43-yard field goal in the fourth quarter.

Then came the play fans remember. With 4:16 to go, Mateer found Isaiah Sategna for a 58-yard touchdown and a 17-13 lead. Sategna finished with nine catches for 121 yards. Mateer completed 23 of 38 passes for 318 yards and two touchdowns, despite three interceptions.

The win left Oklahoma at 10-2 overall and 6-2 in the SEC, with four straight victories, and put the Sooners in strong position for a College Football Playoff spot. LSU ended its regular season at 7-5.
